fishing: WHEN: Mon Oct 19 Small Craft Advisory NNE 15-20kt through late tonight; early morning or evening better before chop builds; residual dirty water from prior fronts/hurricane. PASSES-BEACH: limited by wind, possible snook/reds near passes. LEMON BAY: redfish & small snook around docks/mangroves, mangrove snapper, trout on flats (Fishin Franks / local). NEARSHORE: weather-limited, few opportunities. Baits: live shrimp, gold spoons, soft plastics, pilchards, cutbait.
redtide: FWC Oct 16: K. brevis at background concentrations in 6 samples from and offshore of Southwest Florida (incl. in/offshore Sarasota, offshore Hillsborough). Not present Charlotte/Lee/Collier samples. No fish kills or respiratory irritation reported past week.
bacteria: Englewood Beach GOOD ~20 CFU/100mL (DOH Charlotte Healthy Beaches, latest ~Sep 21). No advisory. Palm Island GOOD.
fpl: Charlotte ~1-3 customers out (<0.01%); Sarasota ~21-65 small isolated (no major Englewood spike).
